email.body1:
Will, saw Paces raised an $11M Series A and is expanding the clean energy data platform nationwide, into Canada, plus new Fractional Development Services.

Expanding coverage that fast usually means more in-market developer accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where good pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Paces off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Will, quick follow-up for Paces.

Going nationwide and into Canada tends to push the pipeline target ahead of what headcount can cover. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Paces needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Paces' reply rate likely compares to other Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
